content: Sneha Roy called Anita Sharma at Trust Wealth Advisors to inquire about the pending status of her health policy (HP-2026-0456). Anita explained that they are waiting for her latest blood test results, a signed declaration of no major surgeries in the past year, and a copy of her ID. Sneha agreed to submit these documents via the portal or email today, and Anita confirmed the policy will be active within 2-3 business days after review.

action_items: Submit signed declaration regarding no major surgeries in the last year
Review and update policy status within 2-3 business days once documents are received
